from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()

sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(1)
st = doc.styles["Normal"]; st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
for h,s in (("Heading 1",14),("Heading 2",12),("Heading 3",11)):
    doc.styles[h].font.name="Calibri"; doc.styles[h].font.size=Pt(s); doc.styles[h].font.color.rgb=RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F)

def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); sh = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    sh.set(qn("w:val"),"clear"); sh.set(qn("w:color"),"auto"); sh.set(qn("w:fill"),color); tcPr.append(sh)

def add_runs(para, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None):
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i,part in enumerate(parts):
        if not part: continue
        r = para.add_run(part); r.bold = bold or (i%2==1); r.italic = italic
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)

def p(text="", bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None):
    para = doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(para, text, bold, italic, size)
    if align is not None: para.alignment = align
    para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    return para

def bullet(text):
    para = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet")
    add_runs(para, text); para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return para

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, font=9):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""; r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(font); r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF); shade(c, "1F3A5F")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i,v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""; add_runs(cells[i].paragraphs[0], str(v), size=font)
            if str(v) == "High": shade(cells[i],"F4CCCC")
            elif str(v) == "Medium": shade(cells[i],"FCE5CD")
            elif str(v) == "Low": shade(cells[i],"FFF2CC")
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i,w in enumerate(widths): row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def issue(num, title, severity, ocg, finding, impact, action):
    doc.add_heading(num + "  " + title, level=3)
    para = doc.add_paragraph(); para.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)
    r = para.add_run("Severity: "); r.bold=True
    para.add_run(severity + "     ")
    r = para.add_run("OCG provision(s): "); r.bold=True
    para.add_run(ocg)
    para = doc.add_paragraph(); para.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2); r=para.add_run("Finding. "); r.bold=True; add_runs(para, finding)
    if impact:
        para = doc.add_paragraph(); para.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2); r=para.add_run("Financial impact. "); r.bold=True; add_runs(para, impact)
    para = doc.add_paragraph(); para.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(8); r=para.add_run("Required action. "); r.bold=True; add_runs(para, action)

issue("A-1","Proposed rates exceed the OCG maximum rate caps","High","3.1, 3.2(c), App. B",
 "OCG 3.1 sets absolute ceilings for 2025: Equity Partner $825, Senior Associate $550, Mid-Level $425, Junior $375 and Paralegal $200. It states that firms “should not propose or include rates exceeding these caps in ... budget submissions.” Three of WG’s five timekeepers are above the cap. **Croft is at $850** (cap $825). The workbook already notes that his 2024 rate was at the cap and that “[a]ny 2025 increase would exceed the cap.” **Okeke is at $575** (cap $550). Her 2024 rate was already at the cap; OCG 3.2(c), using the Senior Associate example, says the rate is set at the cap. **Hu is at $225** (cap $200 for all paralegal levels). Yoon ($425) and Novak ($375) equal their category caps but fail the 3% test (A-2). WG’s justifications (seniority, expanded role, subject-matter expertise, “market rates,” what other clients pay) are exactly the factors OCG 3.1 says do not permit billing above a cap. Lexera will reduce over-cap entries automatically, and the difference cannot be recovered.",
 "Over the budgeted hours: Croft 620 x $25 = $15,500; Okeke 980 x $25 = $24,500; Hu 740 x $25 = $18,500. **Subtotal $58,500.**",
